summary:
​Ever wondered what it takes to become an astronaut? Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer turns space science into a hands-on adventure for young explorers. Instead of just reading about the cosmos, players step directly into the boots of an astronaut—solving unexpected problems, exploring the Solar System, and testing their critical thinking through interactive missions and quizzes.
​Built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge and powered by real data from NASA’s Open Data Portal and APIs, our platform blends genuine science with engaging gameplay.
​We believe every great discovery starts with a spark of curiosity. A child looking up at the stars today could be the engineer or astronaut leading tomorrow's missions. We’re here to make that very first step unforgettable.
​Ready to accept the challenge? Launch your mission today at famous-bonbon-cb6edd.netlify.app. The universe is waiting!
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational website that teaches children about space exploration through astronaut simulations, missions, and games. Players manage resources, solve challenges, and make decisions during space missions. Our goal is to inspire young people to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). We developed the project using JavaScript, React, CSS, and NASA resources. It features six languages and is designed for easy access on different devices. Our team focused on accessibility, creativity, educational value, scientific accuracy, and child-friendly design.
